bug.summary: Tar files created by AIX native tar, and which contain symlinks, cannot be read by TarArchiveInputStream
bug.description:
A simple tar file created on AIX using the native (
/usr/bin/tar
tar utility) 
and
which contains a symbolic link, cannot be loaded by TarArchiveInputStream:

java.io.IOException: Error detected parsing the header
